build_sequential_llama4_text_moe: build a SequentialLlama4TextMoe module from an original Llama4TextMoe and Llama4Config for sequential expert processing
create_sequential_llama4_text_experts: create a SequentialLlama4TextExperts ModuleList that splits fused gate-up projections into separate Llama4TextMLP experts
run_moe_forward_pass: run the forward pass of SequentialLlama4TextMoe with hidden states to get expert-weighted output and router logits
materialize_moe_weights: materialize the fused expert weights into individual expert gate, up, and down projection parameters
review_moe_router_scoring: review the MoE router scoring logic that handles both tuple and raw router logits from different transformers versions
